does: Builds, once when a hit's combat log entry is made on the client, the tooltip lines of its damage text (VMCombatLogTooltipEntry each: armour class, attack roll, damage roll, resistances) from the HitEntry the server sent; the damage roll line is written from the hit's resolved stats expression, not from its list of damage rolls. Hovering only shows what this built.

evidence.says: the macOS build names it (VMHitDamagedEntry::GenerateDamageTooltips, called by the VMHitDamagedEntry constructor); here it is the one function calling eoc::StatsDamage::ResistanceToDisplayString, twice as there, and the only caller of the Damage Roll line builder at code:unplaced::CombatLogDamageRollTooltipLine that runs eoc::StatsDamage::StringVisit

a count-only probe over one weapon hit shows 1 call, from code:gui::CombatLogEntries::VMHitDamagedEntry::VMHitDamagedEntry (itself called once from bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x16BD9CE); the lines it built, read from the view model's nested trans strings, are the player's tooltip (Sneak Attack: 'Damage Roll: 2 (1d4) + 3 (Dex) + 5 (1d6) = 10' while the hit's DamageRolls list only 1d4+3)
the macOS build's symbols hold this name; it is tied to this function by the job its read shows
